description.en: Same as AddParty_Message, but plays the "J_07" jingle instead of "J_08" — used for a more significant/important party-member recruitment.
Param ID of the character to add to the party.
Whether to lock the member's position slot.
Whether to enable the member's Fighting Spirit.
Whether to lock the member's Fighting Spirit.
Level to set for the new member.
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

examples.case: Adding an important member and setting their level (not found in script_clean/; invented, following the AddParty_Message family's real usage pattern)
examples.code:
// Add an important party member with the "J_07" jingle presentation and set their level to 20
AddParty_Important_Message("para_cp0001", true, false, false, 20);

examples.case: Adding an important member without changing their level
examples.code:
// Add an important party member with the "J_07" jingle presentation, keeping their current level
AddParty_Important_Message("para_cp0001", true, false, false);
